Markets.title: US stocks: US market falls as higher oil prices, Treasury yields weigh
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as rising oil prices, higher Treasury yields, and uncertainty over Middle East peace negotiations made investors cautious. Federal Reserve officials also signaled potential interest rate hikes if inflation continues to rise significantly.

Markets.title: Gold tumbles 4% to seven-week low as oil, dollar and yields climb
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped 4% to a seven-week low, driven by a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields. Increased inflation concerns from higher oil prices also contributed to the decline, affecting other precious metals like silver, platinum, and palladium.

Markets.title: 4 Adani group companies settle public shareholding violations case with Sebi. Check details
Markets.summary: Four Adani group companies paid Rs 1.48 crore to settle Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) proceedings regarding minimum public shareholding violations. The companies and their directors settled the 2020 investigation without admitting or denying the allegations.

Markets.title: Paramount rolls out $44 billion bond sale to fund Warner Bros. takeover
Markets.summary: Paramount Skydance Corp. has started selling over $44 billion in bonds to finance its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. This high-yield debt issuance is expected to be one of the largest in corporate history, with initial yields discussing in the low-9% range.

Markets.title: Sebi drops minimum public shareholding norms violation case against Vinod Adani and 4 Adani group companies
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has dropped its investigation into Vinod Adani and four Adani group companies regarding minimum public shareholding norm violations. Sebi concluded that there was insufficient evidence to prove Vinod Adani exercised effective control over the foreign portfolio investors involved.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities plunged on Monday, with the Sensex falling 1,124 points and the Nifty dropping over 360 points to wipe out nearly Rs 8 lakh crore in market value. The broad-based selling was driven by surging oil prices, rising bond yields, geopolitical tensions, and rate-hike concerns.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC gained rare access to a front-line conflict zone in Yemen. Reporters traveled with pro-government soldiers as they battled Houthi forces for control of the city.

Geo-Political.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
Geo-Political.summary: Seoul summoned Ukraine's ambassador after Kyiv publicly revealed the transfer of two captured North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea. Seoul stated the arrangement was originally intended to remain confidential.

Geo-Political.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
Geo-Political.summary: Twelve women have been killed in a single region of South Africa since July. President Cyril Ramaphosa has described these murders as a stain on the national conscience.

Geo-Political.title: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
Geo-Political.summary: French Prime Minister condemned violence following the arrest of 164 individuals during student protests. The students are demonstrating over issues that include overcrowded classrooms.

Geo-Political.title: Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days
Geo-Political.summary: Crowds in Lagos are watching Nigerian man Ben Dancer attempt to break a world record by dancing non-stop until Tuesday morning. He aims to complete seven days of continuous dancing for the feat.

Geo-Political.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
Geo-Political.summary: An Iranian court has upheld a sentence of corporal punishment for singer Parastoo Ahmadi. She was convicted of offending public decency for performing in a sleeveless dress without a hijab during a livestream.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT for a relevant user query. This occurred without the use of paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization strategies.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for content creators looking to stay competitive in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to make the content creation process easier and more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These advanced tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article introduces top AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022 to help users create effective and efficient content. It notes that choosing the right tool from the many options on the market can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal set to embark on 7-day US visit from September 29: G20 meet, trade talks with America on agenda
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal will begin a week-long visit to the United States on September 29. The trip will focus on attending a G20 meeting and advancing discussions on the India-US Bilateral Trade Agreement.

Data & Insights.title: India-UAE target $200bn bilateral trade by 2032; commit to local currencies, payments, digital initiatives — Check here
Data & Insights.summary: India and the UAE have committed to reaching $200 billion in bilateral trade by 2032. To achieve this goal, both nations agreed to implement local currency settlements, integrate payment systems, and adopt central-bank digital currencies.

Data & Insights.title: RBI steps up bond sales to  ₹1 trillion, first time in a decade: Explained
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has increased its bond sales to one trillion rupees for the first time in ten years, signaling a shift toward tighter monetary policy. This move is expected to flatten the yield curve, prompt more open-market operations, and raise borrowing rates.

Data & Insights.title: Why can’t India boost exports to China? Sitharaman flags lack of market access, 'It goes to Vietnam, then China’
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that India struggles to boost exports to China due to a lack of direct market access for goods like pharmaceuticals and buffalo meat. Consequently, many Indian products must be routed through Vietnam before reaching the Chinese market.

Data & Insights.title: Centre set to seek Cabinet nod to extend a dozen flagship welfare schemes
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government will seek Cabinet approval to extend about a dozen flagship welfare schemes before their interim extensions expire on September 30. This renewal process occurs ahead of upcoming assembly elections in five states, including Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat, scheduled for 2027.

Data & Insights.title: India’s industrial output growth hits 8% in August led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output grew by 8% in August, driven by gains in manufacturing and electricity generation. This performance exceeded July's revised growth rate of 7.4% and the 4.7% expansion recorded in August of the previous year.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi Flags 727 Voter Exclusions In Delhi. What Poll Body Said
India.summary: Rahul Gandhi highlighted the exclusion of 727 voters in Delhi and warned that the electoral system must answer for it. He criticized Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the issue.

India.title: Adani Group Cleared Of Minimum Public Shareholding Violation Charges By SEBI
India.summary: SEBI has cleared four Adani Group companies and their directors of violating minimum public shareholding rules. The exoneration applies to Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone, and Adani Energy Solutions.

India.title: Congress Moves Candidates To Secret Location Ahead Of Gandhinagar Civic Polls
India.summary: Ahead of the Gandhinagar civic polls, the Congress has moved its candidates to a secret location. The BJP dismissed Congress allegations that the ruling party is threatening the candidates' families.

India.title: Maharashtra Food Body Suspends 30 Licenses, Seizes Stock Worth A Crore
India.summary: Maharashtra's Food and Drug Administration suspended 30 business licenses across four divisions, including Mumbai and Pune. The agency also seized food stock valued at approximately one crore rupees.

India.title: From 6th-Gen Fighters To AI: 15 Biggest Takeaways From NDTV Defence Summit
India.summary: Senior military commanders and the Defence Minister discussed India's current military capabilities and immediate defense gaps at the NDTV Defence Summit. They also highlighted future warfare technologies, including sixth-generation fighters and artificial intelligence.

India.title: In Slapgate Row, Report Filed Against Delhi Minister, Police Case On AAP MLA
India.summary: During a Sunday road repair inspection, BJP leader Parvesh Verma was filmed slapping AAP MLA Jarnail Singh on the Outer Ring Road. Following the widely circulated video, an official report was filed against a Delhi minister and a police case was registered against Singh.

General.title: Five men arrested in RAF Fairford incident released on police bail
General.summary: Five men arrested following an incident at RAF Fairford have been released on police bail. Investigators are examining whether proxies or individuals acting for a foreign state were involved.

General.title: Watch: RAF Fairford suspects are bailed, what happens now?
General.summary: Several UK men in their twenties from London, who were arrested under the Explosives Act and on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act near RAF Fairford, have been released on bail. Investigators will now continue gathering evidence and decide whether to formally charge the suspects or drop the case.

General.title: UK tries to stop Trump's diesel export ban
General.summary: UK government official John Healey is in discussions with the United States regarding Donald Trump's threatened ban on diesel exports. The UK is attempting to stop the proposed export restrictions through these ongoing talks.

General.title: Best thing we can offer young people is a job, not benefits, says chancellor
General.summary: Ahead of next month's Budget, Chancellor John Healey stated that providing jobs is better for young people than offering benefits. He is facing pressure to reduce government borrowing costs.

General.title: Watch: From launch to fiery splashdown, SpaceX's Starship completes orbit test
General.summary: SpaceX successfully completed an orbital test of its Starship rocket during its 14th launch. The flight featured rapid satellite deployments and ended with a fiery splashdown.

General.title: Mahmood signals rethink on migrants' right to remain
General.summary: Home Secretary Mahmood is signaling a potential rethink regarding migrants' right to remain. This follows pressure from Labour MPs, including Angela Rayner, to water down the proposed policies.
